help: Offline runtime validation of a profile, as the live runner sees it
description: Reproduce the live runner's construction-time validation without credentials or a venue client. Exit 0 accepted, 1 runner objection, 2 config refusal, 3 book-level advisory (report-only; the runner never reads it).
data_root_reason: the profile paths are fixed by the profile and the supervisor

options.help: validate as an armed start (live) or an observer (observe)
account equity in USD for the book-level risk and margin check
backtest-lab provider package directory (default: beside the repository root, as the supervised start uses)
